fleet.notes: Slovak military register, evidence number equals the MSN. Built 2013. Deliberately has no OM- mark: state aircraft in the military register are absent from the civil register, so absence there is not evidence against it. Acquisition contract signed December 2024; no sourced in-service date, so activeFrom is left unset. Previous marks are for provenance research only - flights under them predate Slovak ownership and carried different ICAO addresses. Acquisition: contracts of 16 and 19 December 2024 with United Wings International, USD 23.15 and 24.6 million (about EUR 46 million together). On 16 April 2026 UVO fined the ministry 873 795,52 and 857 965,56 EUR for breaching public procurement law on this purchase and rejected its strategic-investment exemption argument; the decisions are NOT final and the ministry has appealed. No source characterises this as fraud or as a criminal matter. See data/cost-research.seed.json.

Slovak military register, evidence number equals the MSN. Built 2014. Same caveats as 9513. Acquisition: contracts of 16 and 19 December 2024 with United Wings International, USD 23.15 and 24.6 million (about EUR 46 million together). On 16 April 2026 UVO fined the ministry 873 795,52 and 857 965,56 EUR for breaching public procurement law on this purchase and rejected its strategic-investment exemption argument; the decisions are NOT final and the ministry has appealed. No source characterises this as fraud or as a criminal matter. See data/cost-research.seed.json.

Government flying service, operated by the Ministry of Interior air unit. In service since 2016-06-14. ICAO24 from tar1090-db; type and dates from sk/en Wikipedia. Not present in the NSAT civil register (checked 2026-08-21), as expected for a state aircraft.
Remaining airworthy Fokker 100 after OM-BYC was withdrawn in February 2025.

Withdrawn from service on 2025-02-11 and used as a source of spare parts for the remaining Fokker 100. Kept as a historical record only: it is excluded from the current fleet, from ADS-B polling, from cost allocation and utilisation, and from every dashboard figure describing the fleet today. Flights before the withdrawal date remain attributable to it if data for them is ever obtained.
Second A319 of the government flying service. Same caveats as OM-BYA.

sources.title: Ministerstvo obrany objednalo vycvik pilotov na Global 5000 za viac ako milion eur bez sutaze
sources.notes: JOURNALISM, A LEAD NOT A SOURCE. Reports roughly 1.2 million EUR for type and maintenance training of four pilots on the two Global 5000s, awarded to Elite Jet without competition; Elite Jet holds no training approval and bought the training from CAE. Recorded to be replaced by the underlying orders once obtained. Note the ministry is DEFENCE, not Interior, despite order numbers that read as Letecky utvar.

sources.title: Komplexne technicke zabezpecenie udrzby lietadiel Global 5000
sources.notes: A1 for fleet identity: names both airframes explicitly — 'Komplexne technicke zabezpecenie udrzby pre 2ks lietadiel Global 5000 ev.c. 9513 a ev. c. 9633'. Also the scope of the 10M framework, which covers parts, materials, engineering and logistics, not only labour.

sources.title: Register objednavok MO SR
sources.notes: Published orders of the Letecky utvar MO SR. An order is a commitment, not a proof of payment, and most entries do not name an airframe — allocation to 9513/9633 is inference, not record.

sources.title: Tlac 1189: Pisomne odpovede clenov vlady na interpelacie podane do 20. marca 2026
sources.notes: CONFIRMS THE DOCUMENT EXISTS, DOES NOT CONTAIN IT. Item 19 is the answer of Deputy PM and Defence Minister Robert Kalinak to MP Gabor Grendel's interpellation of 4 March 2026 'vo veci letov lietadiel Bombardier Global 5000'. The print is only an index; its closing note says the written answers are held in the members' lounge, so the text is not online. Obtaining it is the single most valuable outstanding lead — an official answer about these flights specifically.

sources.title: eBulletin MO SR
sources.notes: Primary source for the acquisition: 'Ministerstvo obrany tiez kupilo dve dopravne lietadla Bombardier Global 5000 za takmer 46 milionov eur.' The wording is 'takmer', so the figure must not be rendered as an exact number.

sources.title: Informacia o vyuzivani sluzieb Leteckeho utvaru Ministerstva vnutra Slovenskej republiky

The exact session date is not recorded on the downloadable file; the material states its own effect from 2021-01-01. Its internal planning table is consistent with the 3 802 EUR/h rate (768 004 / 202 = 3 802.0), which confirms the figures were read correctly.

research.description: Obstaranie dvoch lietadiel Bombardier Global 5000 za takmer 46 milionov EUR, podla eBulletinu MO SR.
research.notes: The ministry's own wording is 'takmer 46 milionov eur' — approximate, and it must be shown that way rather than as 46 000 000,00. Note the discrepancy worth chasing: the per-airframe figures recorded from the aviation press total 47.75 million USD, roughly 41 million EUR, which does not reconcile with 46 million EUR. Either the USD figures are list prices, or the EUR total includes more than the airframes. Not used by any model — acquisition is capital, and spreading it over flights needs a service life nobody has published.

research.description: Dve objednavky Bombardier Inc. z 3. jula 2025, LU-6/2025-9 a LU-6/2025-10, "technicka a letova dokumentacia pre lietadla", 7 622,80 a 35 696,65 USD bez DPH.
research.notes: PROBABLE, NOT CONFIRMED. Supplier is Bombardier and the buyer is the flying unit, but the orders name no airframe. Used by no model.

research.description: Fixna zlozka na letovu hodinu odvodena z benchmarku: celkove 10 298-12 366 USD/h pri 200-325 hodinach rocne, minus variabilne 7 807-8 368 USD/h, teda 1 930-4 559 USD/h = 1649-3896 EUR/h.
research.notes: Derived by subtraction from the same benchmark, so it inherits every weakness of it and adds one: fixed cost per hour depends entirely on annual utilisation, which for these aircraft is not published.

research.description: Objednavka LU-6/2025-13 z 20. augusta 2025, Bombardier Aerospace Germany, "navigacna jednotka", 21 797,21 EUR s DPH.
research.notes: PROBABLE, NOT CONFIRMED — the order names no airframe. Note also that a component like this may already fall under the 10M maintenance framework, so counting both would double-count.

research.description: Variabilne (priame) naklady typu Global 5000 podla nezavislych komercnych kalkulatorov: 7 807-8 368 USD/letova hodina. Pri kurze ECB 1,1701 USD/EUR (priemer 2026) to je 6672-7152 EUR/h.
research.notes: COMMERCIAL BENCHMARK FOR THE TYPE, NOT SLOVAK SPENDING. Used only because no Slovak operating figure for the Global 5000 has been obtained; a state operator flying few hours may differ substantially. The interval is deliberately wider than the source spread for that reason.

research.description: Objednavka LU-6/2025-14 z 5. novembra 2025, Elite Jet s.r.o., "Zabezpecenie typoveho vycviku pilotov", 164 800 EUR s DPH.
research.notes: AN ORDER, NOT A PAYMENT. One of several: reporting puts the whole training package near 1.2 million EUR. Used by no model — a one-off training cost needs the years and hours to spread it over, and neither is known.

research.description: Typovy a udrzbovy vycvik styroch pilotov na Global 5000, zadany bez sutaze firme Elite Jet, spolu priblizne 1 200 000 EUR. Jedna z objednavok je 164 800 EUR z 5. novembra 2025.

Deliberately used by no model: training is a one-off fixed cost whose allocation depends on how many years and hours it is spread over, and neither is known. Also a caution about provenance — the order numbers read as Letecky utvar MV SR while the ministry is Defence, and this project separates the two on purpose.

research.description: Ramcova dohoda na komplexne technicke zabezpecenie udrzby lietadiel Global 5000, maximalna hodnota ramca 10 mil. EUR na 4 roky
research.notes: A CEILING, NOT SPENDING. It must never be divided by four years and charged to flights: a framework may go largely undrawn. The notice also shows the framework is not a service fee — it covers scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, service bulletins, airworthiness directives, borescope and non-destructive inspections, oil and hydraulic analysis, engine trend monitoring, spare parts, consumables, tooling, component stock and logistics. Calling it 'servis = 10 mil.' would misstate what it buys. Recorded as a lead for obtaining the actual invoices, which would be tier A1. Used by no model.

research.description: Dve pokuty UVO spolu 1 731 761,08 EUR (873 795,52 + 857 965,56) za porusenie zakona o verejnom obstaravani pri nakupe dvoch Global 5000. Rozhodnutia zo 16. aprila 2026.
research.notes: NOT FINAL AND NOT AN OPERATING COST. The ministry filed an appeal, so no money has necessarily been paid and the decisions may be overturned. Deliberately used by no cost model. Recorded because it is a public-money consequence attached to these airframes, and because the file should show what is known before anyone repeats it as settled. UVO found a procurement-law breach and rejected the ministry's strategic-investment exemption argument; no source characterises this as fraud or as a criminal matter, and this project must not either.

benchmarks.label: Priame prevadzkove naklady letunov LU MV SR, 2018-2019
Podiel fixnych nakladov na celkovych nakladoch utvaru
benchmarks.notes: The project specification's historical indication of roughly 30 % direct / 70 % fixed. Our own derivation from the A4 annual budget gives about 72 % fixed excluding payroll, which corroborates it independently. Used only to check that the model is not absurd.

utilisation.notes: The only official annual utilisation figure we have for the fixed-wing fleet.
Minimum required to maintain competency, not an observation. Using it as the denominator more than doubles the fixed cost per hour compared with the 2019 actual.

fixedCosts.derivation: 9 885 780 EUR long-term annual budget at the minimum nalet, excluding payroll, less the direct operating cost at that nalet: 600 h x 3 802 EUR (fixed-wing) + 600 h x 812 EUR (rotary) = 2 768 400 EUR. 9 885 780 - 2 768 400 = 7 117 380 EUR.
fixedCosts.notes: Derived, not stated. The budget figure is official; the split between direct and fixed within it is our arithmetic, and it excludes payroll and capital entirely.

fixedCosts.derivation: 7 117 380 EUR organisation-level fixed cost allocated to the fixed-wing fleet by planned flight hours: 600 / (600 + 600) = 50 %. 7 117 380 x 0.5 = 3 558 690 EUR.
fixedCosts.notes: A second derivation on top of the first. Allocating a shared budget by planned hours is one defensible choice among several; a different allocation method would move this figure.
